question: What effect is targeted: continuous effect, ATE, IV effect, DID effect, RDD effect, or selection-adjusted effect?
Is the outcome measured after treatment and aligned with the causal question?
Is treatment continuous, binary, multi-valued, instrumented, or cutoff-assigned?
Are controls pre-treatment variables, not mediators, colliders, identifiers, or post-treatment consequences?
If using IV, are instruments assigned through z_cols and backed by relevance/exclusion arguments?
Are clusters, units, and time columns represented explicitly when rows are dependent?
Are all outcome, treatment, control, instrument, and design-specific columns finite or intentionally handled?
Does treatment, instrument, running score, or selection indicator have enough support?
Can another analyst see exactly which columns were assigned to each role?
